about_the_game:
Hey Escape Simulator fans! We're super excited to announce our collaboration with PowerWash Simulator. Get ready for an awesome new escape room experience set in the iconic PowerWash garage!

Key Features:
  • Iconic Garage: Dive into the familiar garage from PowerWash Simulator, now turned into a mind-bending escape room.
  • PowerWashing Fun: Clean away grime to uncover clues and hidden secrets. It's PowerWashing with a twist!
  • Co-op: Grab a friend and tackle the puzzles together. Two (or eight) heads are better than one!
  • VR Mode: Fully playable in VR or flat version. Experience the escape room like never before!
  • New Editor Props: Use new 3D props to build your own garage or whatever your imagination creates.
  • New Soundtrack: Enjoy a brand-new rock and roll soundtrack that amps up the excitement.

Can't wait to see you all in the garage!
